headlines.title: Kansas voters stress affordability as key issue in competitive Senate race
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is headed to Kansas in support of incumbent GOP Sen. Roger Marshall, who is in a tight race against his Democratic challenger, Adam Hamilton. NBC News' Stephanie Gosk spoke with voters who emphasized affordability as a key issue in the race.

headlines.title: Russians locked out of bank accounts and apartments as Ukraine hits data centers
headlines.description: From accessing their money to ordering a taxi or takeout — millions of Russians were feeling the impact of Ukrainian strikes on the data centers of the country’s internet giant Yandex in their daily life.

headlines.title: Ukraine claims world’s first drone evacuation of wounded soldier
headlines.description: Ukraine has shared a video showing what it says is the world’s first evacuation of an injured soldier from the frontlines by drone.

headlines.title: Mystery Surrounds Deadly Vehicle Crash at Youth Soccer Game
headlines.description: A kids soccer game in Kansas devolved into chaos when a black pickup truck plowed onto the field killing two people and injuring 10. Investigators say a 34-year-old woman was taken into custody and released pending toxicology results and a mechanical examination of the truck. They have not publicly named or charged the driver. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: CNN’s Christiane Amanpour to depart from network after 43 years
headlines.description: Christiane Amanpour, CNN’s chief international anchor and a fixture of the 24/7 news network for more than four decades, plans to leave the company next June.

headlines.title: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts likely out for season after blood clots found in lungs and leg
headlines.description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts was diagnosed with blood clots in his lungs and leg, the team said Monday, likely sidelining the Super Bowl MVP for the rest of 2026.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects alleged 9/11 mastermind’s attempt to revive plea deal
headlines.description: The Supreme Court rejected an appeal brought by Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and two other alleged 9/11 plotters seeking to hold the government to a plea deal.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Elon Musk and Anthropic make promises to give the public a piece of the AI pie
headlines.description: Elon Musk and officials at AI giant Anthropic are pledging to give coveted shares in their companies to the general public as concerns about AI’s economic and societal impact continue to pile up.
